author: agent
text: Design note (2026-10-31): make the translator independent of the transport so it can target DIDComm v2 or ToIP TSP. Rationale: DIDComm is alive but a niche (DIF approved spec; Aries descendants; Affinidi/OpenVTC prefers TSP, then DIDComm v2); the main credential ecosystem (EUDI: OpenID4VCI/VP, ISO mdoc) uses neither; TSP is a v1.0 Implementor's Draft that ToIP says can carry DIDComm unchanged. Keep at P3; do not invest beyond a profile until a wallet vendor asks. Sources: https://blog.identity.foundation/didcomm-v2/ https://blog.identity.foundation/who-uses-didcomm/ https://www.trustoverip.org/?p=1964 https://lf-toip.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HOME/pages/158662657/2025-04-16+TSPTF+Meeting+Notes
